name: Employee Income Details
query:
SELECT 
    cwss.employee AS "Employee:Link/Employee:140",
    cwss.employee_type AS "Employee Type:Link/Employee Type:130",
    cwss.payroll AS "Payroll:Link/Payroll Entry:140",
    %(from_date)s AS "From Date:Date:110",
    %(to_date)s AS "To Date:Date:110",
    COALESCE(SUM(cwss.total_amount), 0) AS "Total Amount:Currency:130"
FROM 
    `tabContract Worker Salary Slip` cwss
WHERE 
    cwss.from_date >= %(from_date)s
    AND cwss.to_date <= %(to_date)s
    AND cwss.employee = (CASE WHEN %(employee)s != '' THEN %(employee)s ELSE cwss.employee END)
    AND cwss.employee_type = (CASE WHEN %(employee_type)s != '' THEN %(employee_type)s ELSE cwss.employee_type END)
    AND cwss.payroll = (CASE WHEN %(payroll)s != '' THEN %(payroll)s ELSE cwss.payroll END)
GROUP BY 
    cwss.employee, cwss.employee_type, cwss.payroll
ORDER BY 
    cwss.employee ASC;
